purpose: Relay unused bandwidth to first-party Harbor relays after explicit user consent.
listing: Harbor Node shares unused bandwidth only with Harbor-operated relays after you opt in. You can stop sharing at any time.

permission_purposes.storage: Persist consent and kill-switch state on device.
permission_purposes.alarms: Schedule relay heartbeats only after consent.

consent_flow: Options page requires explicit opt-in before any socket opens. Relay code returns immediately when consent is not true.
kill_switch: A runtime message harbor:kill closes the relay socket and stops further connections.
